common_contract.parse: Use shared bounded parser/schema before collaborator calls; reject extra/inapplicable fields, exact-capacity type errors, unsupported mode/format/flag combinations and ambiguous selectors. Paths remain workspace-relative within explicit trusted outer root.
common_contract.modes: Structural-only operations do not silently reinterpret a requested completion gate. agent-output is permitted only on listed role-aware operations with non-null invocation_ref and authenticated invocation; current installed host implementation remains unavailable/fail-closed. All report APIs are root-mode only.
common_contract.flags: Intrinsic mutators act without requiring write=true; dry_run suppresses all effects. Optional publication operations inventory/import-inventory/generate-acceptance/reports publish only with write=true; dry_run+write=true plans without writing. validate-all is the explicit default-publication exception. Pure inspection/individual validation/doctor/read-source and unavailable host operations reject write or dry_run requests that have no supported plan meaning.
common_contract.format: Service transport always emits JSON. json/markdown/both selects report representation only for validate-all and coverage/parity/completion reports. Other operations use format=json; acceptance output_format separately selects markdown/gherkin/both views while retaining structured source.
common_contract.capture: Use trusted ActivationStore selection and InitializationIO/actual capture. RepositoryReader must match the bound I/O repository selection, and writer recapture must retain the same bounded pin selection. No extra ad-hoc source reads. Bootstrap or v1 results use a real manifest of observed bytes/absence without inventing a v2 graph or source identity.
common_contract.authority: ServiceAuthority is an injected trusted carrier, not deserialized JSON. Trusted author ID maps local-user to human and host to agent in existing JsonObject author_or_agent consumers. No request markers, invocation token text, or successful result can grant protected host authority.
common_contract.runtime: Require verified installed code-inclusive RuntimeIdentity; absent/stale/corrupt installed identity yields exit3 with unavailable context, never resource-only/zero digest fallback. Actual package manifest waits for the final serialized build-owner window.
common_contract.result: ServiceArtifact only for supported file kind and valid real digest. Preserve directory/conflict/partial/uncertain effects through fixed counts and actionable findings. Known gate failure remains exit1 even when diagnostic report publication succeeds. Null/unavailable report measures are not converted to zero service counts.

exits.0: Selected operation/gate passes and any requested effects complete.
exits.1: Blocking artifact or selected completion findings; can include successfully published truthful failed report.
exits.2: Malformed request or invalid invocation/configuration/path/version; preserve only recognized context.
exits.3: Installed runtime/dependency/I/O/authentication/authority failure, including interrupted writes; retain partial effect details when context exists.

common_contract.errors: Use typed existing error codes and shared errors; do not parse human sentences or classify every downstream ValueError as an invocation error. Fixed safe diagnostics exclude source snippets/raw exception messages.
common_contract.budgets: Reserve operation input traversal, selected records, aggregate UTF-8 serialization/output and repeated lookup work before allocation. Reuse accepted limits and shared serialization; no new broad parser, repeated whole-graph assessment, or immutable Mapping.items quadratic traversal.

concrete_findings.decision: Directory/nullable-hash output cannot enter ServiceArtifact. Preserve true initialization result; fixed counters/path-specific findings retain directory/conflict/uncertain effects.
Keep approved author_or_agent str; convert using authenticated principal to existing kind/id JsonObject.
Expected-kind/path check then honest graph-wide findings, with no truncated-findings filtering; exact v1 profile compatibility preserved.
Fixed bounded first page; exact requested line range/selection plus total/returned/truncation, no completeness claim.
InventoryRegistry.select and run_inventory injection match; plan_inventory remains installed-only and uses same explicit normalized selection.

Bind a real installed local ServiceIO composition, verified build identity, protected ActivationStore and local-user authority. Do not ship a placeholder provider that rejects every operation or treats missing host authority as local authorization.

ownership_and_size_proposal.rationale: Thirty fixed routes include ten intrinsic/transport mutators and five report/generation compositions. Putting all typed handlers, prospective publication/result mapping and immediate-intent documentation in operations.py is forecast to exceed 500 lines. These are the two already anticipated cohesive handler splits, plus one publication-focused test split; no accepted-module edits or generic dispatch framework.

boundaries.service.py: Lifecycle, trusted context, actual capture, typed error/exit mapping and final shared result validation.
boundaries.operations.py: Fixed operation dispatch, profile/individual graph validation, inventory/read-source and unavailable host routes.
boundaries.service_reports.py: Four authoritative report projections and acceptance generation/rendering with controlled paired/source/view plans.
boundaries.service_mutations.py: Initialization/configuration, draft/CAS/evidence and source-transport/migration composition using existing planners; no raw writer.
boundaries.gateway.py: Bounded single stdin/stdout JSON plus installed local ServiceIO adapter; no shell or request-selected imports.

ownership_and_size_proposal.forecast: Planning estimate, not a formatted measurement: service 250-350, operations 300-420, reports 250-350, mutations 400-480, gateway 250-400, doctor 100-180 lines. All implementation files must remain <=500 after Black; request another exact split only on concrete size evidence.
ownership_and_size_proposal.shared_owners_unchanged: workspace_operations owns shared contracts/serialization/failure schema/acceptance selector; source_inspection_preparation owns analyzer selectors; snapshot_inventory_capture owns build identity. No duplicate lists, ports, baseline or accepted API edits.

focused_test_plan.rule: These are proposed behavioral groups, not collected or passed nodes. Exact final node lists come from the frozen implementation. Do not rerun accepted suites to create this baseline.
focused_test_plan.service_routes: One explicit parameter row for each of the 30 operations. The 28 implemented routes use real validators/planners and isolated captured memory fixtures; prepare/finalize assert typed unavailable with no side effects.
